genre.name: playground tag
traits: the chase: being it is a short panic, not a sentence

verbs.does: touch the player in front of you to pass it on

beats.moment: run at or away from whoever is it
beats.stretch: it passes hands after a chase round the cover
beats.round: 90 s of chases; whoever is it at the end loses

objective.goal: not be it when the clock runs out

reach.how: every player starts in the yard; the it player is always within a short run
risks: a player stuck behind the fence

feel.comedy: the panic of the one who is it
juice: a bonk and a squash on a tag

avoid.guard: a small yard: the chase always comes back round
no ledge or water in the yard
no tag-backs for 2 s, then anyone can be caught

mechanics.as: tag a friend to pass it on

bots: bots chase the nearest player when they are it and run from it otherwise
